note.summary:
1.3 Education and work
Key focus
- school subjects, lessons, teachers, study routines and future careers.

Core language
- Useful structures: मेरे विचार में; मुझे ... पसंद है क्योंकि; पिछले साल; अगली बार; आम तौर पर; मुझे ... चाहिए।
- Distinguish present habits from completed past actions and future intentions; make comparisons accurately.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: मुझे विज्ञान सबसे अच्छा लगता है क्योंकि प्रयोग रोचक होते हैं।

Translate into Hindi:

After university I want to become an engineer and work abroad.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use past and future forms where relevant, and justify opinions with क्योंकि.
questions.modelAnswer:
मुझे विज्ञान सबसे अच्छा लगता है क्योंकि प्रयोग रोचक होते हैं। मंगलवार को मैंने इतिहास का कार्य देर से जमा किया। परीक्षाओं से पहले मैं हर दिन दो घंटे पुस्तकालय में पढ़ता हूँ। मेरे विचार में यह महत्वपूर्ण है और भविष्य में मैं एक नया अनुभव लेना चाहूँगा।

(English translation: I like science most because the experiments are interesting. On Tuesday I handed in my history work late. Before exams I study in the library for two hours every day. In my opinion it is important, and in the future I would like to have a new experience.)
